resource_acl_role_check.name: resource_acl_role_check
resource_acl_role_check.value: "resource_acl"."role" in ('admin','editor','viewer','read','write','comment','share','export','ai','manage','move') and ("resource_acl"."workspace_id" is null or "resource_acl"."role" in ('admin','editor','viewer'))

workspaces_personal_owner_check.name: workspaces_personal_owner_check
workspaces_personal_owner_check.value: ("workspaces"."kind" = 'personal' and "workspaces"."personal_owner_id" is not null and length(btrim("workspaces"."personal_owner_id")) > 0 and "workspaces"."personal_owner_id" = "workspaces"."created_by") or ("workspaces"."kind" <> 'personal' and "workspaces"."personal_owner_id" is null)
